question: Food rich in carbohydrates (like potatoes) and those rich in fats (like butter) are also known as __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Energy - Giving Food**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Foods rich in **carbohydrates** and **fats** are known as **Energy - Giving Foods**.
 
• Carbohydrates are the body's **primary source of energy**.
 
• Fats provide a **long-term energy reserve** and are necessary for the absorption of **fat-soluble vitamins**.
 
• Examples of carbohydrate-rich foods include **potatoes, rice, bread, and pasta**.
 
• Examples of fat-rich foods include **butter, oils, nuts, and seeds**.
 
• Both carbohydrates and fats are essential for maintaining **metabolic functions** and providing **energy for physical activities**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Main Course**__

 __
 
• A **Main Course** is the primary dish in a meal consisting of several courses.
 
• It is typically the most substantial dish and can include a variety of food groups such as **protein, carbohydrates, and vegetables**.
 
 
 
• **Unsafe Food**__
 __
 
• **Unsafe Food** refers to food that is contaminated or spoiled and can cause illness if consumed.
 
• Contaminants can include **bacteria, viruses, parasites, or chemical substances**.
 
 
 
• **Fast Food**__
 
 
• **Fast Food** refers to food that is prepared and served quickly at restaurants or shops.
 
• It often includes items like **hamburgers, fries, pizza, and fried chicken**.
 
• While convenient, fast food is often high in **calories, fats, sugars, and salt**.
